SELECT r."id", r."username", r."nickname", r."email", r."avatar", r."bio", r."role", r."status", r."created_at", r."updated_at", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "BLOG"."posts" p WHERE p."user_id"=r."id" AND p."deleted_at" IS NULL) AS "post_count" FROM "BLOG"."users" r
AND r."status"=#{query.status} AND r."role"=#{query.role}
AND (LOWER(r."username") LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(r."nickname") LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(r."email") LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(CAST(r."id" AS VARCHAR(30))) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')
ORDER BY r."created_at" DESC, r."id" DESC
